summary: Commands run in a sandbox that hides the map and the other trails
text: Every command runs in bwrap: the filesystem is read-only except the workspace and uv's cache, and these are hidden under empty tmpfs: /home/antoniomangoni/.pi, /home/antoniomangoni/code/provenance-notebook, /tmp/claude-1000/-home-antoniomangoni-code-almanaque/24318484-cc7b-48ac-876d-75cb3034c05e/scratchpad/pi-live, /tmp/claude-1000/-home-antoniomangoni-code-almanaque/24318484-cc7b-48ac-876d-75cb3034c05e/scratchpad/synth-r3b. The project_map tool runs outside the sandbox.
